## Notes

- Demolition Chart (SPI 24.18): per item, how a ground unit reduces, clears, destroys, dismantles, unblocks or blows it (by_units false = the chart's 'not allowed'), the stages or timing, supplies spent or recovered, and which other causes (air bombardment, barrage, strafing, desert raider raids) also affect it; the chart's key restated in the schema's builder enum
- The road row prints '1' in the stages column although no unit may destroy a road; kept as printed
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 104) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p10): 0 of 13 rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
